name: journal-study-v1
status: pre-specified before any kinematic/physics model result was computed
evidence_boundary: April-August 2025 fits every model. September 2025 is the only period used for risk/sigma fitting and conformal calibration (two disjoint flight halves by stable hash). October 2025 is a forward temporal test for every model defined here; the inherited project had earlier inspected October aggregates for its own metadata/ADS-B model, so October is a development-era forward test, not a sealed confirmatory set.

hypotheses.H1: Adding SI kinematic and OpenAP physics features to the metadata+ADS-B gradient boosting model lowers October MAE; paired flight-cluster bootstrap 95% CI excludes zero after Holm correction.
hypotheses.H2: Physics-informed models (openap_calibrated, hgb_residual_physics, hgb_full) have lower MAE than hgb_metadata_adsb on aircraft types withheld from training (leave-one-type-out), for the majority of eligible types.
hypotheses.H3: Duration x aircraft hierarchical Mondrian conformal intervals calibrated on September attain >= 0.85 coverage in every eligible October cell, whereas constant-width split conformal does not.
hypotheses.H4: At a 75% release target, the accepted-MAE cost of a 50% group representation floor is smaller (in kg) for hgb_full than for hgb_metadata_adsb.

no_tuning_statement: Hyperparameters are copied from configs/phase-3-baselines.json with max_iter raised to 400 and were not searched on any evaluation period.
